• Sipërfaqe totale: 116.2 m²

• Orientim: Perëndim

Për më shumë informacion ose për ta vizituar, na kontaktoni.
description_en: We have a 2+1 apartment for sale. The apartment is located in Yzberisht, Rruga Besim Alla, in an area with easy access to main roads and close to daily services. Apartment information: • Floor: 7 • Total area: 116.2 m² • Net area: 101 m² • Orientation: West The apartment has: • Living room with kitchen area • 2 Bedrooms • 1 Toilet • 1 Balcony Other settings: • Furnished with contemporary furnishings • West orientation provides natural lighting and pleasant views during the afternoon • Functionality and high quality of life For more information or to visit, contact us.
